title: Monarch of the Glen

ai_content.desc_en: Archie MacDonald, a young restaurateur, returns to his childhood home of Glenbogle where he is told he is the new Laird of Glenbogle. He finds himself facing new challenges in this home he has returned to, while trying to revive his hometown and establish new businesses there. But he soon discovers that being the Laird is not just about owning the land, but also about the people and the community that live there.
